question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d29-- member whose basename ends O0.elf. Count the STT_FUNC entries of its SHT_SYMTAB symbol table that are defined (st_shndx is not SHN_UNDEF). A stripped member has none. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

generator_cmd: sh ot_gen.sh  # gcc -O0 -g / gcc -O3 -g of ot_twin.c; d29--sample-O0/O3.elf copied from the D29 GM evidence
oracle_cmd: readelf -sW d29--sample-O0.elf | awk '/Symbol table .\.symtab/{s=1} s && $4=="FUNC" && $7!="UND"' | wc -l
